moments.title: The Hundred Continues Today
moments.blurb: The Hundred cricket tournament continues today with double-header matches: Trent Rockets vs Sunrisers Leeds (Women's and Men's games) at Trent Bridge.

angles.name: Match Day Excitement
angles.copy: It's another exciting day in The Hundred! Trent Rockets take on Sunrisers Leeds at Trent Bridge today. Who are you backing?

angles.name: Live Cricket Vibe
angles.copy: Sun's out, bats are swinging! The Hundred action is live today with Trent Rockets facing Sunrisers Leeds. Catch the highlights later!

moments.title: Jazz Cafe Festival Today
moments.blurb: The Jazz Cafe Festival takes place today, Sunday, August 2nd, at Burgess Park in London, featuring a lineup of soulful music.

angles.name: Festival Sunday
angles.copy: Sunday vibes in the capital! The Jazz Cafe Festival is happening today at Burgess Park. Who's heading down for some amazing music?

angles.name: Smooth Sounds
angles.copy: Bringing you the smooth sounds of a Sunday festival! The Jazz Cafe Festival is live in London today. Perfect for chilled out vibes.

moments.title: Sub Club Southside Weekender Closes
moments.blurb: Glasgow's Sub Club Southside Weekender concludes today, Sunday, August 2nd, at Queen's Park Arena, with a lineup of house and techno favourites.

angles.name: Glasgow Party Finale
angles.copy: Last chance to catch the beats! The Sub Club Southside Weekender wraps up today at Queen's Park Arena. What a weekend for Glasgow!

angles.name: Dance Music Wrap Up
angles.copy: The dance floor is still buzzing! Sub Club Southside Weekender finishes its run today. Who caught the incredible house and techno sets?

moments.title: Luke Combs at Wembley Final Night
moments.blurb: Country superstar Luke Combs plays the second and final night of his Wembley Stadium residency in London today, August 2nd.

angles.name: Wembley Country Night
angles.copy: Yee-haw, London! Luke Combs is back at Wembley Stadium tonight for his second and final show. Expect some serious country magic!

angles.name: Sold Out Superstar
angles.copy: Another sold-out night for Luke Combs at Wembley! If you're there, get ready for a fantastic show. What's your favourite Luke Combs track?

moments.title: Scottish Summer Bank Holiday
moments.blurb: Monday, August 3rd, is the Summer Bank Holiday in Scotland, a day off for many across the country.

angles.name: Long Weekend Starts
angles.copy: Happy long weekend, Scotland! Tomorrow is the Summer Bank Holiday. How are you planning to spend your extra day off?

angles.name: Monday Off
angles.copy: Don't forget, Scotland gets a Bank Holiday tomorrow! Enjoy the extra day off. What's the plan?

moments.title: Strictly Launch Show Ticket Ballot Closes
moments.blurb: The ballot for free tickets to the recording of the Strictly Come Dancing 2026 launch show closes on Tuesday, August 4th, at 10pm.

angles.name: Last Chance for Strictly
angles.copy: Want to be in the ballroom? The ballot for Strictly Come Dancing launch show tickets closes Tuesday at 10pm! Get your application in!

angles.name: Be There Live
angles.copy: Quick! Don't miss your shot to be at the Strictly Come Dancing launch show recording. Ticket applications close on Tuesday!

moments.title: Happy Birthday Geri Halliwell
moments.blurb: Geri Halliwell (Geri Horner), singer-songwriter and former Spice Girl, turns 54 on Thursday, August 6th. (Born August 6, 1972).

angles.name: Spice Up Your Life
angles.copy: Girl Power! Geri Halliwell turns 54 on Thursday. What's your favourite Spice Girls memory or solo Geri track?

angles.name: Ginger Spice Turns 54
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 54th birthday to the iconic Ginger Spice, Geri Halliwell, on Thursday! Still 'It's Raining Men' after all these years?

moments.title: Happy Birthday Bruce Dickinson
moments.blurb: Bruce Dickinson, legendary frontman of Iron Maiden, celebrates his 68th birthday on Friday, August 7th. (Born August 7, 1958).

angles.name: Metal Icon Birthday
angles.copy: Up the Irons! Bruce Dickinson, the one and only voice of Iron Maiden, turns 68 on Friday. What's your favourite Maiden anthem?

angles.name: Flight of Fancy
angles.copy: From pilot to heavy metal legend, Bruce Dickinson celebrates his 68th on Friday! Send your birthday wishes to the Iron Maiden frontman.

moments.title: Happy Birthday The Edge
moments.blurb: David Howell Evans, better known as The Edge, guitarist of U2, turns 65 on Saturday, August 8th. (Born August 8, 1961).

angles.name: U2 Guitar Legend
angles.copy: Happy 65th birthday to the unmistakable sound of U2, The Edge, on Saturday! What's your favourite U2 riff?

angles.name: Iconic Sound
angles.copy: The man behind some of the most iconic guitar sounds, The Edge, celebrates his 65th on Saturday! Wishing him a great day.

moments.title: Roots Picnic London This Weekend
moments.blurb: The Roots Picnic makes its international debut at Crystal Palace Bowl, London, this weekend, August 8th-9th, bringing hip hop, music, and culture.

angles.name: Hip Hop in the Capital
angles.copy: The legendary Roots Picnic hits London this weekend for its international debut! Get ready for two days of incredible music and culture at Crystal Palace Bowl.

angles.name: Weekend Festival Vibes
angles.copy: London's Crystal Palace Bowl is hosting the first ever international Roots Picnic this weekend! Who's excited for the fusion of music and culture?

moments.title: Maiden Voyage Festival This Weekend
moments.blurb: Maiden Voyage Festival returns to Burgess Park, London, this Saturday, August 8th, with a stacked lineup of electronic music favourites.

angles.name: Electronic Beats in London
angles.copy: Get ready to move! Maiden Voyage Festival is back at Burgess Park this Saturday, bringing a huge lineup of electronic artists to London.

angles.name: Dance Festival Alert
angles.copy: This Saturday, Maiden Voyage Festival takes over Burgess Park! Expect a day of non-stop electronic music from some of the best in the game.

moments.title: Eastern Electrics Festival Returns
moments.blurb: After a year's hiatus, Eastern Electrics Festival makes its return to Burgess Park, London, this Sunday, August 9th, with a new lineup.

angles.name: Sunday Dance Revival
angles.copy: Eastern Electrics is back! Head to Burgess Park this Sunday for the return of this epic London festival. Who's excited?

angles.name: Festival Comeback
angles.copy: It's been a year, but Eastern Electrics is returning this Sunday! Get ready for a huge day of dance music in London.

moments.title: UK Weather North-South Divide
moments.blurb: The UK is experiencing a significant weather divide, with southern England and Wales facing continued heat and dry conditions, while Scotland and northern England see cooler temperatures and more frequent rain.

angles.name: Heatwave South, Rain North
angles.copy: It's a tale of two weather systems across the UK! Southern regions are still basking in heat, while the North gets more rain. How's it looking where you are?

angles.name: Southern Dry Spell
angles.copy: Another hot and dry one for Devon! The UK's weather divide continues, with the South staying warm. Remember to stay hydrated!

angles.name: Welsh Weather Watch
angles.copy: Still feeling the heat in Wales! The south of the UK is holding onto its dry, warm spell. Stay cool out there!

moments.title: Nigella Lawson Joins Bake Off
moments.blurb: Nigella Lawson has been confirmed as the new judge for The Great British Bake Off, replacing Prue Leith, with the new series expected to air in September.

angles.name: Bake Off New Era
angles.copy: A delicious new chapter for The Great British Bake Off! Nigella Lawson is joining Paul Hollywood as the new judge. Exciting times in the tent!

angles.name: Cooking Queen in the Tent
angles.copy: Nigella Lawson joining Bake Off is the news we kneaded! Her expertise will be a fantastic addition to the show. Can't wait for September!
